features.title: Register a service and start polling it
features.intent: A team can register a service with a health-check URL and poll interval, and the poller starts checking it.
features.serves: journey step 1: the team registers a service with a health-check URL
acceptance: A newly registered service is polled at its configured interval and its first result is recorded.

features.title: Public status page shows current status and history
features.intent: The public page renders each service's current status and a 90-day history bar from stored transitions.
features.serves: REQ-AC3: the public page renders a 90-day history bar per service from stored transitions
acceptance: The public page shows every registered service's current status and a 90-day history bar built from its recorded transitions.
